description: We are a team of 6 members, students of Aristoteleio College High School.
summary: We have created an interactive educational simulation  to manage a space base on Mars. The survival mission lasts 7 in-game days. But this is not just a game. Players make decisions that affect their day-to-day life and have an impact on the future. The problem we aim to address is the lack of interactive and engaging educational tools that present the real challenges of a space mission in a simple and accessible way. This game uses simulation-based experiential learning, allowing students to make decisions, observe their immediate and long-term consequences, and develop critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
details: We have created an interactive educational simulation in Roblox Studio. It's for children aged 7–12, as well as primary school teachers, as a tool for experiential learning and decision-making. The player has to survive in a 7 in-game days. Every decision has a real cost in oxygen and energy but a benefit too, such as food and oxygen. There is no correct or wrong decision , every choice has a real impact for the next day. It retrieves space-weather events from the past 7 days through the NASA DONKI API and uses the data day by day so that decision-making scenarios change based on real forecasts. Furthermore, it has Educational and life skills impact. Users learn through hands-on experience, decision-making, and problem-solving. Knowledge is linked to an experience. It transforms the user from a passive recipient of information into an active participant in a mission with real challenges and consequences. Critical thinking and data evaluation. Resolving unforeseen situations. Decision-making under pressure with limited resources. Adaptability to changing conditions. Resilience in the face of failure.
